newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three youths held in connection with France fires.
newsitem.headline: Three youths held in connection with France fires.

text.p: Three youths, suspected of setting forest fires near this southern French port, were detained near the site of new blazes early on Saturday, police said.

Several thousand hectares (acres) of forest were destroyed in the area last weekend and some isolated homes had to be abandoned despite efforts by fire-fighting aircraft and emergency service reinforcements from across the country.
